newsitem.title: USA: Simpson Industries completes Holset deal.
newsitem.headline: Simpson Industries completes Holset deal.

text.p: Simpson Industries Inc said Monday it has completed its purchase of the Great Britain-based vibration attenuation business of Holset Engineering Company Ltd, a subsidiary of Cummins Engine Co Inc.

Combined purchase price and transaction costs totaled about $76 million. Financing in the amount of $65 million was through a private placement of debt, power train and chassis products maker Simpson said.

"With the inclusion of our new international business, we are looking for total sales of about $440 million in 1997," chief executive officer Roy Parrott said in a news release. "We expect Simpson's 1997 net income to be reduced by about two cents a share as we absorb transition costs in the second half. For 1998 and beyond we expect a net addition to Simpson's profitability from our new international business."
The transaction is effective June 29, 1997, and financial results will be consolidated in the third quarter beginning July 1, the company said. The acquired business supplies
rubber dampers for light and medium-duty engines and viscous dampers for heavy-duty diesel engine customers.
Simpson shares were unchanged at 10-1/2 Monday.
